description: This Kotlin source file defines the SplashActivity class for an Android TV application. The activity acts as a lightweight splash screen that displays upon app launch, with a dark background and centered app title. It preloads an image into the Coil cache for smoother rendering, and transitions to MainActivity after a 3-second delay. The activity uses lifecycle-safe handlers and performs cache warm-up for visual assets.

classes.name: SplashActivity
classes.description: An Android TV splash screen activity that displays a themed, non-interactive startup screen, preloads critical images into cache, and transitions to the main activity after a delay.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the splash screen, warms up image cache, and sets up delayed navigation to MainActivity.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up pending callbacks to prevent memory leaks when the activity is destroyed.
